description: Shows a store's setup checklist (store details, card, poster, first customer, staff app), plan limits and usage, and its cards with rewards, locations and posters.

intent.description: Optional. One short sentence on what the person asked you to do, e.g. "Set up a stamp card for Ground Up Café". Leal shows it in the person's activity log under Settings → AI agents, so they can see what was done for them. Leave out customer details.

store_id.description: Store id from list_stores. Optional when the login has one store.

name: get_store_setup
title: Get store setup
